# id: PG-pg-84-balance-medic
# covers: PG 191 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 7D80DBB3+ (D7A60E49 ok), harness 33087EDE+ (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: Avarek (medic, 5 Basic First Aid Kits) treats Beaks: per point healtime ... wound 30 gives Beaks full
#   health, no bandages and the same three cuts, then times the first aid at speed 1. Beaks is NOT
#   protected while treated (protect heals wounds). Result = bandaging added per game second.
# verify: finished=1 in every point; own50 > none = first aid reads the hooked Medic.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Beaks
clearjobs Avarek
give Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit" 5
teleport Avarek Beaks dist 4
protect Beaks off
give Avarek "Iron Hat" 1
equip Avarek "Iron Hat"
pg_info Avarek "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- w1: skill 10, gear none ---
setstat Avarek medic 10
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
teleport Avarek Beaks dist 4
speed 1
@set H healtime Avarek Beaks wound 30 timeout 600 ~ (seconds_bandaging=[\d.]+ bandaging [\d.]+ -> [\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,191,medic,10,0,none,w1,heal,0,${H},-
give Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit" 1
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w2: skill 90, gear none ---
setstat Avarek medic 90
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
teleport Avarek Beaks dist 4
speed 1
@set H healtime Avarek Beaks wound 30 timeout 600 ~ (seconds_bandaging=[\d.]+ bandaging [\d.]+ -> [\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,191,medic,90,0,none,w2,heal,0,${H},-
give Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit" 1
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w3: skill 50, gear none ---
setstat Avarek medic 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
teleport Avarek Beaks dist 4
speed 1
@set H healtime Avarek Beaks wound 30 timeout 600 ~ (seconds_bandaging=[\d.]+ bandaging [\d.]+ -> [\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,191,medic,50,0,none,w3,heal,0,${H},-
give Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit" 1
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w4: skill 50, gear own25 ---
setstat Avarek medic 50
pg_clear Avarek ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" medic 25 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus Avarek medic ~ equipped_bonus=25% .*match=1
teleport Avarek Beaks dist 4
speed 1
@set H healtime Avarek Beaks wound 30 timeout 600 ~ (seconds_bandaging=[\d.]+ bandaging [\d.]+ -> [\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,191,medic,50,25,own25,w4,heal,0,${H},-
give Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit" 1
hunger Avarek 280
# --- w5: skill 50, gear own50 ---

pg_force_affix Avarek "Iron Hat" medic 50 tier 6 ~ affixes=

speed 0
